newsitem.title: USA: Vencor to buy TheraTx for $17.10 a share.
newsitem.headline: Vencor to buy TheraTx for $17.10 a share.

text.p: Vencor Inc said it signed a definitive agreement with TheraTx Inc to buy all of TheraTx's roughly 20.7 million shares for $17.10 per share in cash.

The transaction has been recommended by the boards of both companies, according to Vencor, which said it expects to start the tender on February 14. It expects to close the transaction within 90 days, it added.
Vencor did not say how soon the acquisition would be accretive to its earnings.
No officials at either company could be immediately reached for comment.
Vencor said the acquisition would broaden its menu of Vencare contract services. Both companies are health care service providers.
Shares of Vencor were up 1/4 in early trading at 32-3/4, while shares of TheraTx were up 3-1/2 to 16-5/8.
